events.line: Veton, you absolute coward—benched Purdy for 28.5 points while he was projected for 20.6, and now you're watching him torch your bench like some kind of fantasy masochist.

Ilir, you absolute coward—benched Bryce Young and he goes off for 24 points like he's finally figured out how to read a defense, and you're sitting there with your projected 16-pointer on the bench watching this unfold. That's some peak fantasy incompetence right there.
Arben, JSN just put up 38 fucking points and somehow still exceeded expectations—congrats on accidentally looking like a genius this week, you absolute fraud.

Rinor, you absolute fucking donkey—benching a guy who just dropped 20.4 points on you? That's not caution, that's fantasy malpractice, and your playoff hopes just got cremated by your own stupid couch.

Rilind really said "nah, I don't need 13 extra points this week" and benched Schultz like he was droppable—absolutely gutted the guy on the bench and watched him put up 20 while your starter took a shit.

Arben benched Jake Ferguson and watched him drop 18 fucking points from the bench—that's what happens when you panic-fade a guy who's been your most consistent target in Dallas's red zone, you absolute coward.

Faton, you absolute coward—benched Bateman when he was putting up 18 fucking points, and now you get to watch him eat your bench all week while you started whatever waiver wire corpse you thought was safer.

Josh Allen just dropped a 40-burger on you and somehow still exceeded expectations—Ilir, your boy went full God mode while you were probably sweating him at 22.7 projected, but hey, at least you had the balls to start him when it counted.
Rilind benched a guy who just dropped 18 points on the bench—what the fuck were you thinking, leaving that kind of production sitting on the sideline while your starter probably shat the bed?

Flamur, you absolute madman—CeeDee just doubled his projection and you're out here looking like a genius when we both know you started him because you were too lazy to check the waiver wire, not because you had some grand mastermind plan.
